title: diff-review findings document
description: The single JSON document a diff reviewer returns: what was reviewed, how completely it was read, one finding per observation in the framework findings-schema shape (criterion id, file, line, status, evidence), and exactly one verdict. Self-contained: no external references, so non-IDPF consumers can validate it with any draft-07 validator.

issue.description: Issue number the range was reviewed against

filesListed.description: Files in the range, from git diff --numstat, binary files included

diffLinesListed.description: Added plus removed lines across the range; a binary file contributes 0

countedNotRead.description: Files not read in full because a cap was reached. Never omitted: an empty array is the claim that everything was read.

binaryFiles.description: Files git diff --numstat reported as binary (a - - row), which have no line count and cannot be read as hunks. Never omitted: an empty array is the claim that the range held none.

findings.description: At least one entry per criterion in review-criteria.json; one entry per violation.

criterion.description: A criterion id from review-criteria.json, or an extension's criterionPrefix followed by the checklist item

file.description: Path the finding is anchored to; null when not line-anchored

line.description: Line in the post-change file; null when not line-anchored

evidence.description: What was seen: a quoted line, a commit subject, or the AC a hunk maps to

verdict.description: Exactly one verdict, derived by the verdict rule in review-criteria.json
